character.name: Saigo
character.text:
You may take a dead player's Stance into your hand. Bare hands deal 2. In the draw phase, +1 card per Stance on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} your Stance stays, and enemies return their Stances to hand.

character.name: Hanzo
character.text:
You may block direct attacks with a weapon at the cost of one wound. You may discard a Defense to draw 2.
{After your death} discard any number of Weapons: a thrust for 1 wound each, all at one enemy.

character.name: Ushiwaka
character.text:
Draw a card for every wound you take. Death's door for you: 1 or 2 life.
{After your death} enemies take 1 wound.

character.name: Iyo
character.text:
Once per turn, move your Trap to an ally without one, or swap any two Traps on the table unseen. Your Trap triggers on thrown attacks too. In the draw phase, +1 card per Trap on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} enemy Traps are revealed.

1.name: Katana
1.text: While you hold a Stance, deal 1 extra wound.

3.name: Kanabo
3.text:
On a successful attack, the target discards a random card.
Favourite weapon of {Saigo}.

5.name: Traitor's Dagger
5.text:
In the {Assassin} stance, deals 1 extra wound.
A {Ninja}'s strike cannot be defended and ignores Traps.

18.name: Sai
18.text: This weapon may be played as a Defense.

38.name: Makibishi
38.text:
May be played as a Trap that deals 1 wound back to the attacker.
Favourite weapon of {Iyo}.

41.name: Snare
41.text: Take three cards from the attacker.

42.name: Straw Decoy
42.text: The attack fails and the defender draws 2 cards.

43.name: Bear Trap
43.text: The attacker takes two wounds from the Trap's owner. Then this card moves onto them as an Effect: attacks against them are always complexity 1 — Armor and other complexity increases do not help.

47.name: Insult
47.text: You insult the attacker. For a {Samurai} this is worse than death: they take this card as an Effect of rage and must discard a card with every direct attack.

58.name: Horseman
58.text: Attacks against you are 1 harder. Your weapon handles 1 more complexity. Attacking complexity 1, you deal 1 extra wound.

59.name: Lotus
59.text:
When played, restore 2 life.
Before each draw phase you may: restore 1 life to any player {OR} draw a card.

64.name: Vial of Poison
64.text: Your attack now inflicts Poison and deals 1 extra wound.

82.name: Peacemakers
82.text: Each other living player discards a Defense or a Weapon, or hands you a card of their choice from their hand.

91.name: Killer's Mark
91.text:
Every attack against you deals 1 extra wound, and the attacker draws a card.
{The player who kills you} draws two cards.

92.name: Antidote
92.text: You cannot be Poisoned. Any Poison on you is cleared.

107.name: Stitches
107.text:
Any living player of your choice restores 2 life. In the {Chaplain} stance, restore 1 life more.
{At death's door} you may heal another player for 3 life.

108.name: Seppuku
108.text:
Lay all your cards face up in front of you. Your living allies may take any of them, up to the limit of 8 cards; the rest go to the discard pile. You then die and another player scores a victory point. You cannot lose your last victory point this way.
{Ninja} cannot commit Seppuku.

122.name: Death by Fugu
122.text: Play this card to deal two wounds to a Poisoned player.

1200.name: Martial Mastery
1200.text: On their turn any ally may tuck any number of Modifiers face up under the Aura. For every two, all attacks by {allies} deal +1 wound, up to +3 in total.

events.text: Game 7 begins: 4 players, 2v2 (samurai vs ninja), 10-turn test cap. Seat 0 (P0, Saigo) has the banner and starts.
Turn 1 begins — P0 (Saigo) is up.
P0 submits a full turn: stance, then an attack on P3.
events.notes: Open with Horseman for the complexity bonus, then Katana the far Ninja before he can set a Trap.

events.text: P0 sets the Horseman stance.
P0 (Saigo) attacks P3 (Iyo) with Katana (2).
events.notes: First strike while I still have surprise.

events.text: P3 has nothing to answer with and takes the blow.

data.reason: no Defense-capable card, no Trap, no character option

events.text: Katana connects for 4: base 2, +1 Horseman vs complexity 1, +1 for P0 holding a Stance.
The attack resolves: P3 (Iyo) drops to 1 life.
Draw phase: P0 draws 3 + 1 (Saigo: one Stance on the table). Ninja team (P1, P3) each draw 1.
Turn 2 — P1 (Hanzo) is up.
P1 submits a turn: a Trap, then a probing attack on P0.
events.notes: Iyo's already at 1 life — everyone will pile on him. Test P0's defenses first and set a Snare in case he swings back.

events.text: P1 sets a Snare face down.
P1 (Hanzo) attacks P0 (Saigo) with Shuko (1).
events.notes: Just testing what he's holding back.

events.text: P0 defends with a Parry.
events.notes: A Parry costs me nothing important and keeps my life total clean.

events.text: No — Parry blocks any one direct weapon attack outright, regardless of its power.

data.question: Does Parry need to match the damage type to block?
data.ruling: No — Parry blocks any one direct weapon attack outright, regardless of its power.

events.text: The attack is fully blocked: no damage.
Draw phase: P1 draws 3 (no bonus). Samurai team (P0, P2) each draw 1.
Turn 3 — P2 (Ushiwaka) is up.
P2 submits a turn: a trade, an Aura, then an attack on P1.
events.notes: Trade off some dead weight, put up Martial Mastery so our Modifiers start paying dividends, then poison Hanzo.

events.text: P2 discards Bokken and War Fan (both Weapons) to draw 1.
P2 sets the Martial Mastery aura.
P2 (Ushiwaka) attacks P1 (Hanzo) with Kanabo (3), modified by Vial of Poison.
events.notes: Poison ticks even if he blocks part of it — worth spending the modifier.

events.text: P3 intervenes for their teammate with a Sai (Defense-as-intervention, partial absorption).
events.notes: Sharing the wound so Hanzo doesn't drop to critical again.

events.text: Yes — Sai's printed defense value (2) reduces the wound total first; Poison still transfers in full on whatever gets through.

data.question: Does an intervening Sai absorb a Poisoned hit the same as a normal one?
data.ruling: Yes — Sai's printed defense value (2) reduces the wound total first; Poison still transfers in full on whatever gets through.

events.text: 4 power − 2 absorbed by Sai = 2 wounds through.
P1 is now Poisoned.
Kanabo's text: on a successful attack, the target discards a random card.
The attack partially connects: 2 damage, plus a forced discard.
Draw phase: P2 draws 3 (no bonus). Ninja team (P1, P3) each draw 1.
Turn 4 — P3 (Iyo) is up.
P3 submits a turn: a heal, a Trap, an AoE, and an Effect.
events.notes: One hit from dead — patch up, plant a proper Trap, mark Saigo for later since he opened this fight.

events.text: P3 plays Stitches, targeting themself.
events.notes: Can't afford to stay at 1 life.

events.text: P3 restores 2 life.
P3 sets a Bear Trap face down.
P3 plays Peacemakers.
events.notes: Everyone still holding a fat hand should feel it.

events.text: P0 responds: discards Spiked Shield.
events.notes: Spiked Shield isn't doing much for me right now.

events.text: P1 responds: hands over Straw Decoy.
events.notes: I'd rather hand over Straw Decoy than lose a Weapon.

events.text: P2 responds: hands over Tameshigiri.
events.notes: Take the Tameshigiri, I'm not attacking with it this turn anyway.

events.text: Spiked Shield goes to the discard pile.
Straw Decoy passes from P1 to P3.
Tameshigiri passes from P2 to P3.
Peacemakers resolves: everyone else gives something up.
P3 places Killer's Mark on P0.
P3's plan repeats the same Killer's Mark on P0 a second time by mistake; the referee rejects the duplicate.

data.reason: Killer's Mark already present on the target

events.text: Draw phase: P3 draws 3 + 2 (Iyo: two Traps on the table). Samurai team (P0, P2) each draw 1.
Turn 5 — P0 (Saigo) is up.
P0 submits a turn: Death by Fugu on the Poisoned P1.
events.notes: Hanzo's still Poisoned and I've got Death by Fugu burning a hole in my hand — end him before Antidote saves him.

events.text: P0 plays Death by Fugu, targeting the Poisoned P1.
events.notes: Two guaranteed wounds on a Poisoned target — take the kill.

events.text: Death by Fugu deals 2 wounds to the Poisoned P1.
Killed by Death by Fugu while Poisoned.

data.cause: Killed by Death by Fugu while Poisoned.

events.text: P1's Snare goes to the discard pile on death.
P1 loses a victory point on death.
P0 scores a victory point for the kill (living, other faction, non-Poison source).
Hanzo's after-death text: discard any number of Weapons for a 1-wound thrust each, all at one enemy.
Hanzo's dying thrust: 2 discarded Weapons hit P0 for 1 wound each.
Draw phase: P0 draws 3 + 1 (Saigo: one Stance on the table). P1 is dead and skips; P3 (the other living ninja) draws 1.
Turn 6 — P1 (Hanzo) is up.
P1 (Hanzo) revives at full life.
P1 submits a turn with recovery: a Trap, an Effect, then an attack on P0.
events.notes: Back from the dead — dump the dead weight, set a fresh Trap, clear this Poison before it ticks, then avenge myself on Saigo.

events.text: Recovery: P1 discards 2 stale cards, then draws back up to 7.

P1 plays Antidote on themself.
P1's Poison is cleared before it can tick.
P1 tucks a Tameshigiri under P2's Martial Mastery aura.

events.notes: A Ninja's strike with this dagger can't be defended — Killer's Mark makes it sting extra.

events.text: P0 cannot answer an undefendable strike.

data.question: Does Killer's Mark trigger on an undefendable attack too?
data.ruling: Yes — the Mark only cares that an attack connects, not how it bypassed defenses.

events.text: The attack connects for 2.
Draw phase: P1 draws 3 (no bonus). Samurai team (P0, P2) each draw 1.
Turn 7 — P2 (Ushiwaka) is up.
P2 submits a turn: Seppuku.
events.notes: Rough hand, nothing worth swinging with. Feed it to Saigo, deny the Ninja any value from my death, and I'm back at full health next round.

events.text: P2 plays Seppuku.
events.notes: A clean reset is worth more than this hand.

events.text: P2 lays their remaining hand face up for allies to take from.

Seppuku: a ritual death.

Draw phase: P2 (the active player) is dead and draws nothing. Ninja team (P1, P3) each draw 1.
Turn 8 — P3 (Iyo) is up.
P2 (Ushiwaka) revives at full life.
P3 submits a turn: discard to the hand limit, a character ability, then an attack on P0.
events.notes: Hand's overflowing — trim it down, swap traps around, then cash in on Killer's Mark myself.

Iyo's ability: swap any two Traps on the table.

data.choice: Swap traps: my Bear Trap with P1's Insult, unseen.

events.text: P0 has nothing to answer with.

Yes — the Stance stays active exactly as if he were alive; only its owner is dead. No enemy holds a Stance, so the 'return to hand' half is a no-op.

data.question: Saigo's after-death text keeps his Stance on the table — does it still count for Katana's bonus while he's dead?
data.ruling: Yes — the Stance stays active exactly as if he were alive; only its owner is dead. No enemy holds a Stance, so the 'return to hand' half is a no-op.

events.text: No — a killing hit only grants the two-card death bonus, not both.

data.question: Killer's Mark says the killer draws two cards — does that stack with the normal 'attacker draws a card' text?
data.ruling: No — a killing hit only grants the two-card death bonus, not both.
